mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS decline periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window during easing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the federal funds rate above 2.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising policy rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.5%, or FEDFUNDS stays above 2.5% for < 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising concurrently, indicating aggressive monetary tightening and inflationary pressures, this dual trend compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) during periods of concurrent FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases, or Rank IC >0.05 over any 3-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or UNRATE remains above 4.5% for < 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (GDP) growth signals robust economic demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during periods of GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 1-year rolling window during expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (demand) rises while INDPRO (supply) declines, indicating potential supply-side constraints, this imbalance fuels inflationary pressures and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during periods of GDPC1 up and INDPRO down, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high HOUST (demand) alongside elevated UNRATE (labor) signals approaching economic peak, reducing growth prospects and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods with high HOUST and UNRATE, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-year window during such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward crossing of PAYEMS below 140,000 (in thousands) indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) when PAYEMS crosses below 140,000, or PAYEMS remains below 140,000 for < 15 days.
